description:
Gate-run records are stored and read by key, so reading one issue's runs, its latest run of a gate, or a reusable verdict never reads another key's records.

## Background

Gate runs are stored flat, and readers enumerate and parse them. This story stores runs per issue, makes each issue's gate state the route to its latest run of a gate, finds reusable verdicts through a per-key verdict record, captures only the evaluated issue's named runs into gate mutations, and moves recorded runs into that layout through the format cutover.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Reading one issue's latest runs or its run history opens only that issue's run records.
- [hard] REQ-02: Reuse reads one verdict record and the run it names.
- [hard] REQ-03: Gate evaluation, precheck planning and validation's precheck-history capture capture no other issue's run records; the record-fidelity pass of whole-repository validation is the named history reader (f8a6b298 REQ-13).
- [hard] REQ-04: This repository's recorded runs, latest-run references and verdict records are in the per-key layout, and every cited run id resolves.

## Decisions

- D-1 (steward ruling, just-in-time-6a for the user, 2026-11-04; plan DEC-27): REQ-03 names the epic REQ-13 exception. Whole-repository validation's record-fidelity pass reads every gate-run and verdict record by design; holistic-review 2413b19d F1 had read the unqualified criterion as forbidding it.
title: Gate runs are addressed per issue, per gate and per inputs digest
